full_page.content:
1934, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. S.
Page 196 Cont.
May 30 Herbert Green - 40 - colitis, hemorages etc. Harper Hosp.
Mrs. Eliz. McCormick - operated 10 months ago for cancer - fears it is returning.
Edwin Friytag - 26 - nervous breakdown - wants to join .... Geo. Friytag T.B. has wife & two. Phylis n. c. - 9 mo. - mental .. . improving Peters, Mrs.
1934, June
Page 197 June John Zawartha - 53 - paralys. Irene Power - 21 - arthritis 5 yrs. Father of Irene - Lumbago.
6 Julia (Audley) Sarsfield - Operation for Gall- stone & Appendicitis - Successful ...
Mrs. Stringer - 64 - neuritis ... suffering James Whitty about 52 - paralysis (?) cancer of bowels. Florence Marentette - 37 - heel wrenched Matilda Van Wallegham - 38 - Colitis
11 George Flury - 53 - non Cath., paraly'd 6 yrs. enrolled (June 11) Today.
John Regan - 48 - threatened cancer on lip - has Fam. of 5 depend- ing on him.
Anna Driscoll - Water-board - nervous
11 Henry Kline - 32 - lost to family since 1925, now reported in dying condition - cancer of stomach - in New York.
Boy Cordino - 7 - Fits ...
